title: Fix Daily Report regression: show one record per day with data + working scrolling + period summary

requirements.text: Fix the Daily Report so it reliably returns and displays one aggregated record per calendar day (within the selected date range) for days that have pickups, and it does not collapse multiple days into a single displayed day.

quotes: Yes, only one record shows on daily report. It should show daily totals for each day in range, just as it used to.
One record displayed per day. Only show days with data.

acceptanceCriteria: Given imported data containing pickups on multiple distinct dates within the selected range, the Daily Report displays a separate daily breakdown card for each date that has pickups.
The Daily Report does not display any days that have zero pickups in the selected range.
Daily breakdown cards are sorted chronologically by date.

The UI does not use a deduplication strategy that can incorrectly drop legitimate days (e.g., if the backend already aggregates by day, the frontend should render the returned days as-is; if dedup is still needed, it must not collapse distinct days).

requirements.text: Ensure the Daily Report dialog supports scrolling so all daily breakdown cards and the final summary are reachable on both desktop and mobile (including the reported case where it appears 'not scrollable').

quotes: When results of daily report are displayed it just looks like scrolling is not working. Just get first day in range.

acceptanceCriteria: With enough daily breakdown cards to exceed the dialog height, users can scroll within the Daily Report dialog to view all days and the summary.
Scrolling works using mouse wheel/trackpad and touch scrolling on mobile.
The dialog content remains within the viewport (no content is rendered off-screen without a way to reach it).

requirements.text: Keep (or restore) the end-of-period summary section for the selected date range, and ensure its totals match the sum of the displayed daily breakdown totals for the period.

quotes: If course show summary at the end for the period.

acceptanceCriteria: The Daily Report shows a 'Summary' section after the daily breakdown list whenever the report returns data.
Summary totals (meter totals, tip totals, grand total, total owed driver) equal the sum across all included days (days with pickups) for the selected range.
If no days have pickups in the selected range, the UI shows the existing empty state message and does not show a misleading non-zero summary.

requirements.text: Add/extend a manual regression check document entry specifically for this issue: multi-day daily report after import should show all days with data and be scrollable.

quotes: Import said it worked. But, only one record shows out if 134 records in last file implemented.
Yes, only one record shows on daily report. It should show daily totals for each day in range, just as it used to.
I just want it to work like it used to before it broke.

acceptanceCriteria: The repo includes an updated manual QA checklist (can extend the existing daily report multi-day test) that explicitly verifies: (1) import a file with many pickups across many days, (2) open Daily Report for a range covering those days, (3) confirm multiple day cards render and the list scrolls to the end summary.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit frontend immutable paths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*).
Use English for any user-facing text.
Preserve existing import behavior (already reports success) unless a change is strictly required to fix daily report correctness.
nonGoals: Adding pagination or infinite scrolling to the Daily Report beyond restoring functional scrolling within the dialog.
Changing the Export/Import UI/UX or file format beyond what is necessary to make the daily report accurate.
Adding new report types or additional analytics fields not already present in the daily report payload/UI.
